unlisted_practices: Ensure methodologically robust use of generative AI in clinical pharmacy practice research.
Verify the accuracy of generative AI tool information in detail and transparently, in close collaboration with data and information-technology scientists.
Validate a custom LLM using a validation dataset, error analysis, and consistency, sensitivity and specificity measures, then fine-tune the model.
Obtain feedback from prescribers across a wide range of specialities as a final validation step assessing accuracy, comprehensiveness, relevance to practice and utility.
Compare LLM outputs against state-of-the-art systematic reviews to assess the quality, completeness and accuracy of the information.

screen.reason: Editorial commentary discussing the development of a custom LLM (DELSTAR) for clinical pharmacy research on delirium and highlighting opportunities and governance/verification challenges.
